name: grok-search
description: Live web search, source extraction, URL fetching, and site mapping through the hosted GrokSearch HTTP MCP service.

interface.shortDescription: Search and fetch current web sources
interface.longDescription: Use the hosted GrokSearch HTTP MCP service for live web search, source extraction, URL fetching, and site mapping. This Codex overlay omits mcpServers so ChatGPT GitHub import is not Desktop only. Live ChatGPT tools use Create MCP plugin with HTTPS OAuth. Desktop Cursor/Claude/Grok keep mcp.json and GROK_SEARCH_MCP_TOKEN.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search the web and cite the current sources.
